decisions.statement: A task is reached by the id the addon has and by the task's slug alike.
A completion whose instant is not above zero is refused.
A task completed twice in one logical day is counted once.
A recurring task takes a rolled due date and keeps its page.
A task with no rule is marked done and keeps its page.
A cumulative task at its cap is marked done rather than rolled.
A task at its cumulative cap that no completion named is marked done at the end.
A task already marked done is marked done no second time.
A completion whose timestamp is zero clears the keys that completion set.
The keys a completion touches are read from the page type marked.
A completion is written nowhere but on the task the completion names.
A task no completion resolves is reported and skipped.
Every reach outside this module is an argument the caller may hand in.
An argument the caller leaves out defaults to the real thing.
A landing that refuses stops the import.
A clearing that refuses skips that task rather than stopping the import.
A task is rolled by the account's characters' progress rather than by a whole-task completion.
A task due beyond today is not rolled.
A task stating no recurrence is not rolled.
A task already marked done is not rolled.
The roster a task is judged against is every character the account has.
A roll moves the due date alone.
A roll the store refuses skips that task rather than stopping the import.
A recomputation that fails is reported rather than stopping the import.

definition: a task capture read into completions marked on the tasks themselves
